config.video_studio.title: Video Studio
config.video_studio.help: Edit up to sixty minutes at up to 4K and 24–60 fps. FFmpeg and FFprobe must be installed on the server. Leave the executable path empty to use PATH. Optional AI clips use Video Generation settings.
config.video_studio.export_limit_help: At least 512 MB (a smaller value is raised to 512 MB) and never more than the maximum project size.
config.video_studio.unavailable: Enable Video Studio and install FFmpeg/FFprobe on the server. Open the app for details.
config.video_studio.hardware_encoding_he: Automatic tests the graphics hardware once and falls back to the CPU.

config.confirm_enable.delete: This lets the agent delete data. Deleted data may not be recoverable.
